# A rectangular future-logger correction for complete QQ16 recovery

## Contract and source

This transforms the exact full decoder in canonical
`research/qq16-line-normalized-decoder/WORD.json` (ywz65 / PR2707, built on
Arham Tahir / PR2681). It keeps all224 original x0/y0 outputs in F17, all224
current X2/Y2 fields borrowed and unchanged, and no early retention. It adds
112 exclusively owned full-cover temporary arrays D_p, initially arbitrary,
which return to zero in identity frame. Peak owner-private scratch remains16.

The complete inverse and native source algebra are inherited and rerun after
byte authentication. The new statement is a same-output transformation of the
future-logger inverse, not a new global inverse theorem or physical supplier.
PR3952's96-output projection and PR3963's missing-boundary audit motivate this
full-recovery repair but are not executable dependencies.

## Exact rectangular operator

Let A_p be the actual stage2 alignment, on a physical field:

    A_p = C_qp^(-1) M_p.

The source's full modulo-four phase identity states

    A_p F17 = F16 D_p,

where D_p is the actual ordered owner action and F16 is the coordinate product
on axes9 through24. M_p includes its source-derived affine payload translation.
Its inverse is M_p^(-1) C_qp, with the inverse translation transported by the
owner matrix. These are arbitrary-payload operator identities; the checker
compares all73 linear/quadratic phase coefficients at every ADD.

At the entry to the future-logger block, W_p has logical u_p in F17. The original
block conjugates every112 field by A_p, forms

    q_k = sum_(p in U+T) R[k,p] D_p u_p,

and updates only A ports by

    y1_p = u_p - D_p^(-1) (sum_k R[k,p] q_k / 4), p in A.

All U+T ports remain u_p. The disjoint query and response supports are the
reason the all-field return conjugations can be replaced by a rectangular
correction. There is no commutation of distinct owner actions.

The new block is:

1. For p in U+T (104 ports), clear owned D_p in F17, copy W_p into it,
   apply M_p and then C_qp^(-1). These query copies have F16 and logical D_p u_p.
2. Clear D_p at the8 A ports in F16. At each owner form all8 private q_k from
   the104 query copies, then write `-sum_k R[k,p] q_k/4` into D_p at A ports.
   Every query is complete before the response fields are updated. Clear all8
   private q fields in identity frame and finish the entire owner body before
   visiting another owner.
3. For p in A apply C_qp and M_p^(-1) to the correction D_p. It now has F17
   and the required ordered negative correction. Add it to original W_p.
4. Clear all112 D fields in identity frame. The original104 query-source W
   fields have remained untouched in F17 throughout.

This produces exactly the original future-logger boundary. Therefore its
unchanged predecessor and unchanged F0-inverse suffix produce the same224
original outputs. Temporary clearing is legal because every D is owned;
no inverse operation is needed to erase a disposable owned query copy.
Clears are charged, not treated as free native inverses.

## Native legality and verification scope

The stage2 maps and positive/inverse line operators are the exact source
operations. Every native event occurs outside an owner-private body. The
complete physical source row convention and affine map order are retained.
The new interpreter extends the source checker only with the112 owned D fields
and their required zero/identity return. Existing Z/W output dirt and private
F/G dirt remain adversarial. Borrowed X/Y are compared at exit with their
original content and frames; all224 outputs are checked in F17.

The verifier executes the whole fused word twice: on224 independent current
X/Y symbols against the source's separate inverse formula, and on224 original
x0/y0 symbols forwarded through F0/B1. It checks the intermediate inverse-B1
checkpoint and all final outputs using exact rational coefficients with
ordered owner matrices. The adapted predecessor signed-kernel checker verifies both signs for all112
ports on all512 columns (114688 columns), binds every224 occurrence to its
recipe, and rejects a missing negative-wrapper translation. This is explicit source reuse, not a code-disjoint native proof.

The inherited phase identities plus linearity and ordered cover action extend
the local result to arbitrary arrays and positive tensor lengths under the
same native-child contracts. Finite symbolic replay alone is not a physical
tape implementation, numerical stability analysis or all-depth admission.
In particular the addition path changes, so predecessor rounded-error bounds
must not be transferred without a fresh error and dirty-range argument.

## Budget interpretation and stopping point

With the older hypothetical one-consumer-per-F/B-pair rate, unchanged m73,
W896/9, centre64 total mass and ideal rank51 idle relaxation, the224-H1
consumer gives the exact outward enclosure

    1.000046718879394463 <= G <= 1.000046718879394464.

It fails that model even when H8 and all physical overhead are absent. The
same model's integer threshold is121 passing /122 failing. This is not a
lower bound of224, a proof that every full inverse fails, or rejection of an
actual global caller. The pair incidence is not established by the local
word; the first F0/B1 cut occurs at a different frequency in the retained
nine-stage schedule. Rebuilding that incidence and coverage can change the
numerical conclusion. The sibling contribution handles that separate ledger;
this package does not import its pending result.

The session stops at this complete local identity and invoice. A physical or
global construction needs an actual caller, integer invocation count, live
family stock, coverage, physical movement/storage, precision, dirty-state
bounds, and both all-depth supplier caps. Existing QQ16 core centre removal
is not claimed again as credit. A passing relaxation under another incidence
would still not discharge these obligations.
